statement.notes: Only the 'depreciation_and_amortization' field was requested for extraction. The values were sourced from the supplementary reconciliation table (Note 43(a)), which clearly lists 'Depreciation of property, plant and equipment, investment properties and right-of-use assets' and 'Amortisation of intangible assets and land use rights' as separate line items. These two items are combined to represent the total depreciation and amortization expense added back to net profit in the cash flow reconciliation. All other fields from the schema were omitted as they were not present in the request.
